task_completion.description: Agent opens and reads the alert file ~/Documents/ogle_alert.txt to retrieve target coordinates and observation parameters.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal window showing the contents of ogle_alert.txt with target OGLE-2026-BLG-0042.

task_completion.description: Agent inputs the correct RA (17h 54m 32s) and Dec (-30d 12m 45s) into the telescope control software.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The telescope GUI showing RA and Dec fields populated with values matching approximately 17.908h and -30.212 deg.

task_completion.description: Agent enables telescope tracking and slews to the target coordinates.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The telescope GUI status changing from 'Parked' or 'Idle' to 'Tracking' or 'Slewing', and the sky map centering on the target.

task_completion.description: Agent selects the R-band filter (Slot 4) for the observation.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The filter wheel control in the GUI showing 'R' or 'Slot 4' as the active selection.

task_completion.description: Agent initiates a time-series sequence of at least 15 exposures of 15 seconds each.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The sequence progress bar or log showing multiple exposures (at least 15) being captured with an exposure time of 15s.

task_completion.description: Agent captures a screenshot of the sky view and creates a summary log of the observation.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A final report, log file, or image viewer showing the captured sky field and a summary of the observation parameters.

integrity.description: The agent used the telescope control GUI rather than just manipulating files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse cursor movement and interaction with buttons/fields in the telescope software interface.

integrity.description: The agent waited for the sequence to complete rather than skipping to the end.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots showing the progress of the exposure count (e.g., 1/15, 5/15, 15/15).

integrity.description: The agent retrieved coordinates from the alert file rather than using pre-known values.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen opening ogle_alert.txt before entering coordinates into the GUI.

privileged_info_for_vlm: Target: OGLE-2026-BLG-0042. Coordinates: RA 17h 54m 32s (17.90888h), Dec -30d 12m 45s (-30.2125 deg). Required Filter: R-band (Slot 4).
